description: Domain-agnostic agentic workflow with project profile + layer flags. Durable memory: docs/memory/*; AGENTS.md identity; .memory/* generated cache only. Indie ship: code-loop and shape-lite skip full plan re-run.

rules: Layer off → do not plan, sync AGENTS section, assign worker, or load skill for that layer
Plan checklists are conditional on active-layers.json / AGENTS.md §0
Porting: fill AGENTS.md §0 then run profile-sync.py — do not hand-edit matrix/manifest per repo

designArtifacts.note: UI tasks: Design Contract is primary context for designer/frontend/judge. Only when layer frontend=on.

codeLoop.note: Bug/fix/small implement only. Agents filtered by active layers.

shapeLite.note: Compact idea shaping. Does not force GENESIS or full-stack sections.

fullModule.note: Full path when scope is structural. Respects active layers.

context.note: Context builder filters agents/skills by active-layers.json when present.

orchestrationPrinciples: Context Packet first — prefer packet tiers over dumping folders
Scoped repo read allowed — worker-scopes.json bounds editable paths
Never ban application source reads required to implement or fix
Cursor-first runtime — multi-tool adapters are non-goals for this policy
Heuristic scores only — no ML ranker required
Indie continuous ship — code-loop and shape-lite must not force full workflow re-entry
Domain-agnostic — no product lock-in; layers selected by AGENTS.md §0
Layer-off means absent — never inject database/tenancy/queue into FE-only or BE-only plans
porting: 2. Fill AGENTS.md §0 Project Profile (profile + layers on/off) — required.
3. Fill §1–§3 for layers that are on; leave optional sections as N/A when layer off.
6. Do NOT hand-trim plan-feature.md, agent-matrix, or skills-manifest per project.
7. Day path: /fix for bugs, /shape-lite for ideas, /plan-feature only when structural.
